card.name: "Mind" and "abide" after never/not
card.fires_on: The words "mind" after "never" (never mind that) and "abide" after "not", "failure to" or "agreement to". Also weakly inside a few odd words like leucovorin.

modes.label: Never mind

modes.description: The word "abide" before "by" when talking about following rules or agreements.
modes.example: Failure to<< abide>> by the requirements in these regulations may result

modes.label: Inside odd words
modes.description: Weak firing partway through leucovorin or foreign-language words.
